ambient_events: The room goes quieter. Not less noisy. Quieter.
Somebody at the back stands, crosses the floor, sits down again, and nobody looks up.
A bench creaks in the empty half of the hall.
description: A long, low hall of dressed red stone, doors open on the pad. A clerestory of narrow windows along the roof holds the last of the sun. No tower, no bell, no symbol. It's the biggest building here.
name: The Waking Hall
